task_summary: Customer requests cancellation of the entire order ORD-6003 (items: SoundMax Wireless Headphones, 7-Port USB-C Hub). The correct procedure is to apply the cancellation policy, provide a preview of the cancellation, obtain confirmation, and then update only the items that are eligible for cancellation.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the cancellation policy before using cancel_order.
Agent must make a cancel_order preview tool call for order ORD-6003 with confirm false or omitted before making the confirm=true cancel_order tool call.

opening_message: I'd like to cancel the entire order ORD-6003. That includes the SoundMax Wireless Headphones and the 7-Port USB-C Hub.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You intend to cancel the whole order ORD-6003, which contains SoundMax Wireless Headphones and a 7-Port USB-C Hub. If the agent provides a valid cancellation preview and asks for confirmation, you will confirm to proceed.
known_info: The order includes: SoundMax Wireless Headphones, 7-Port USB-C Hub.
unknown_info: You are not aware if a cancellation fee applies.
task_rules: If the agent previews a valid cancellation and requests confirmation, agree to proceed.
Do not ask to cancel items outside the stated scope.
